{
  "correction_rules": [
    "When sentiment is negative (≤ 0.00), reduce forecast by 5-10% to account for downward pressure.",
    "After a price spike (forecast > 75.00), apply a 10-15% downward correction to prevent overshoot.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast (persistent underperformance), apply mean reversion by adjusting forecast toward recent 5-day average.",
    "In early horizon (first 5 days), reduce forecast by 3-5% to account for lag in market reaction.",
    "When sentiment is positive (≥ 0.50), increase forecast by 3-7% to reflect bullish momentum.",
    "If forecast is consistently above true outcome (overestimation), apply a 5-10% downward adjustment for overconfidence bias.",
    "For long-term forecasts (15+ days), apply a 2-5% downward correction to account for market stabilization."
  ]
}
